llmcord.py:280.why: The AsyncOpenAI client at llmcord.py:156 is built per-request with base_url/api_key picked at runtime from config['providers'][provider], a user-defined provider list in config.yaml (openrouter, openai, x-ai, google, azure-openai, lmstudio, ollama, vllm). The admin-controlled /model command (llmcord.py:77-90) switches curr_model, which changes which provider/base_url is used, including several non-OpenAI/Anthropic hosts. Per rule, a base URL picked at runtime from a user-defined provider list is kept even if one entry is OpenAI.
